Main.Title: Payments Report
Main.Intro: Select a date range and optionally a library. Data is loaded from Alma Analytics.
Main.NoData: No transactions were found in the selected period.
Main.AnalyticsNote: Source: Alma Analytics – Fines and Fees.

Errors.Libraries: Could not load the library list.
Errors.Dates: Enter valid From and To dates.
Errors.DateOrder: The To date must not be earlier than the From date.
Errors.Popup: The browser blocked the print window. Allow pop-up windows for Alma.
Errors.Csv: The CSV file could not be created.
Errors.Analytics: Could not load the Analytics report.
Errors.NotConfigured: The app is not configured. Open Configuration from the app menu and set the Analytics report path.

Config.Title: Configuration
Config.Intro: Set the path to the shared Alma Analytics report. The setting is institution-wide.
Config.PathHelp: The report must be stored in a Shared folder and the path must begin with /shared/.
Config.LoadError: Could not load the app configuration.
Config.PathShared: The Analytics report path must begin with /shared/.
